card: Replaces platform-specific `strerror_r` and `strerror_s` boilerplate in `SysErrorString` with standard C++ `std::system_category().message(err)`. This removes the `STRERROR_R_CHAR_P` CMake introspection check and an entry from the locale linter exceptions list. It is an internal cleanup with no user-facing changes or external dependencies.
changed_since_previous: The earlier version also attempted to remove `Win32ErrorString` and route its callers through `SysErrorString`. This version retains `Win32ErrorString` intact, limiting changes to `SysErrorString` and the removal of the `STRERROR_R_CHAR_P` CMake check.
evidence: PR description points to libcxx source showing `std::system_category().message(err)` dispatches internally to `strerror_r` / `strerror_s` and safely handles unknown errors
problem: Bitcoin Core maintained custom preprocessor branching and a CMake feature test to deal with thread-safe `strerror` variants across different platforms, even though standard C++ provides portable errno translation via `std::system_category()`. The custom implementation was unnecessary boilerplate.

risk.why: If a platform standard library improperly implements std::system_category().message, error logging could output incorrect strings or fail during error reporting.

summary: Replaces platform-specific handling of `strerror_r` (both GNU and POSIX variants) and Windows `strerror_s` in `SysErrorString` with `std::system_category().message(err)`. Also removes the `STRERROR_R_CHAR_P` CMake introspection check and the related locale-dependence linter exclusion.
